title: Beach Soccer Pro
description: Kick up golden sand under sunny palm skies—time acrobatic bicycle volleys and crisp flick shots to dominate tropical beach football matches.
controls: Swipe or tap controls to aim kicks, pass along the sand, and score past the goalkeeper.

zh-CN.title: 阳光沙滩足球
zh-CN.description: 清凉夏日风阳光沙滩足球：在椰林沙滩上来场爽快足球对决，凌空倒钩精准射门拿下夏日冠军杯！
zh-CN.controls: 滑动或点击操控球员传射，找准角度踢出弧线球攻破球门得分。
